name: Ebb Palm
description: Draw the qi back as the tide ebbs and strike with the palm as it turns to flow.

name: Flow Guard
description: Let the guard arm flow outward with a blow and carry its force past the body.

name: Ebbing Step
description: Fall back a pace on the ebb and return a pace on the flow without breaking the stance.

name: Flow Wash
description: Wash an ally in a flowing tide of qi that carries away poison and a clinging curse.

name: Ebb Pull
description: Pull the opponent's footing out on the ebb and strike as the weight is lost.

name: Flowing Counter
description: Turn a strike on the ebb and return it on the flow in one unbroken curve.

name: Flowtide Crush
description: Crush the target under the full weight of the flood tide gathered through both palms.

name: Ebb Draw
description: Draw the opponent's qi out and down on a long ebb until the limbs go heavy.

name: Ebb Embrace
description: Open the body to a heavy blow and let the ebb draw its force away into reserve.

name: Ebbflow Cycle
description: Strike on the flood and guard on the ebb and strike again in one unbroken cycle of the twin tides.

name: Dew Palm
description: Press a dew-damp palm into the target so the cold bead of qi stings and numbs.

name: Dewfall Guard
description: Let a fine fall of dew settle into a thin shell before the chest that softens a blow.

name: Dew Step
description: Tread lightly on dew-slick ground with the weight barely set and the footing sure.

name: Dew Mend
description: Let the settling dew of healing qi gather on an ally's wound until the flesh knits.

name: Dewfall Wash
description: Bring down a slow dewfall over a poisoned ally that lifts the venom out through the skin.

name: Dew Needle
description: Gather a dewdrop of qi to a hard needle and pierce a gap in the opponent's armour.

name: Dewfall Veil
description: Hold a veil of settling dew over a wounded ally that blunts blows and slowly mends the hurt.

name: Dewfall Revival
description: Lay the dewfall over a person whose breath has just stopped and draw the heart back into its beat.

name: Silver Dewfall
description: Bring a heavy silver dewfall down over several allies to close deep wounds and cleanse their blood.

name: Dewfall Renewal
description: Let the school's long dewfall rest on an ally until wounds close and the spent reserve fills again.

name: Crest Palm
description: Throw a palm at the peak of a rising curve of qi so the force arrives at its height.

name: Crest Shell
description: Lift a curved crest of qi on the forearm that breaks an attack over its top.

name: Crest Step
description: Rise onto the front foot and ride the curve of qi into the opponent's space.

name: Crest Salve
description: Pass a rising curve of healing qi along an ally's bruised arm to lift the swelling.

name: Cresting Lash
description: Lash a cresting wave of qi across the guard so the strike lands and the arms are flung wide.

name: Crest Counter
description: Take a blow up the curve of the crest and throw it back at the attacker in a returning strike.

name: Crest Sense
description: Send a crest of qi across the field and read the shape and the weight of every body it passes.

name: Crest Draw
description: Lift an ally on the crest of a wave of qi so strength and speed rise together.

name: Wavecrest Crash
description: Bring the whole wave down from its crest onto the target in one great blow.

name: Cresting Swell
description: Raise a field of cresting waves around the user that knocks every nearby opponent off balance.

name: Crest Spear
description: Gather a whole crest to one hard point and drive it through armour and guard together.

name: Crestfall
description: Let the school's great crest fall in two tracks at once and drive the opponent down under it.

name: Dive Palm
description: Drop onto the target with a downward palm and the whole body falling behind the hand.

name: Plunge Ward
description: Fold the arms over the head as if diving and let a shell of water qi take the blow.

name: Plunge Glide
description: Dive low and glide forward just above the ground on a long skin of qi.

name: Plunge Press
description: Press the opponent down under a plunging weight of qi so the blow lands and the legs fold.

name: Plunge Mend
description: Dive a hand of healing qi deep into an ally's wound to close it from the bottom up.

name: Plunge Hook
description: Hook a plunging line of qi round the opponent's ankle and haul the body down.

name: Plunging Crush
description: Fall from a leap with the weight of deep water in the fist and crush the guard beneath it.

name: Plunge Shroud
description: Pull a dense shroud of deep water qi round the body that muffles even heavy blows.

name: Deepest Plunge
description: Sink into the deepest layer of qi so strikes land on the surface and are swallowed.

name: Plunge Descent
description: Dive from above and cut down through the guard and rise with the strike already thrown.

name: Tidal Palm
description: Press a palm into the target with the slow great weight of the tide behind it.

name: Tidal Guard
description: Hold the forearms before the body as the tide holds the shore and let blows break.

name: Tidal Step
description: Advance a measured pace as the tide advances and give no ground when it is pushed.

name: Tidal Pull
description: Draw the opponent in on the pull of the tide and strike the body that arrives.

name: Tidal Mend
description: Raise a slow tide of healing qi from the core through an ally's wounded body.

name: Tidal Wash
description: Wash a tide of clean qi through an ally and carry out taint and soul erosion.

name: Tidal Press
description: Press the weight of the tide on the opponent so the strike lands and the qi sinks.

name: Tidal Crush
description: Bring the full tide down through the fist onto a single point.

name: Drowning Swell
description: Raise a rolling tidal field around the user that pushes and drowns every opponent within it.

name: Tidal Seal
description: Lock a foe's core with the weight of a standing tide so no qi can leave it for a span.

name: Tidal Crown
description: Raise the school's two courts of tide together and crown the strike with the second court as the first lands.

name: Freshet Palm
description: Loose a freshet of water qi through the palm in a sudden burst at a sworn word.

name: Freshet Guard
description: Throw up a quick freshet before the body to break the line of a blow.

name: Freshet Dash
description: Dash forward in the open on the leading edge of a freshet with no cover.

name: Freshet Lash
description: Whip a hard narrow freshet along the bearing into the opponent's face or hands.

name: Freshet Salve
description: Run a clean fresh stream of qi over an ally's wounds until the bleeding stops.

name: Freshet Sense
description: Send a thin freshet ahead along the bearing and read the bodies it flows round.

name: Freshet Surge
description: Raise the freshet to a heavy surge that drives through the guard along the sworn bearing.

name: Freshet Flood
description: Spread the freshet across the open ground in a low wide flood that sweeps feet from under opponents.

name: Freshet Passage
description: Dissolve into the freshet and pass through a barrier or a body to flow out on the far side.

name: Freshet Arrival
description: Send the sworn freshet down the bearing and strike with it and guard in it and arrive with it.

name: Brimwater Palm
description: Fill the palm with water qi to the brim and release it all in one sworn blow.

name: Brimful Guard
description: Hold the arms like full vessels so that a strike only sets the water within them rocking.

name: Brimful Step
description: Step carefully so that nothing spills and the reserve is kept whole through the move.

name: Brimful Draw
description: Let a brimming draught of qi spill from the user into an ally's depleted reserve.

name: Brimful Mend
description: Pour the overflow of the user's reserve into an ally's wounds to close them.

name: Brimful Wash
description: Pour a brimming wash over an ally's blood to flush poison and Qi Deviation backlash.

name: Brimful Press
description: Press with a full reserve behind the hand so the strike lands and the stance is shoved apart.

name: Brimful Burst
description: Burst the full vessel through a straight punch and let every drop of the reserve land at once.

name: Brimful Veil
description: Hold a veil of brimming qi over the allies that guards them and refills their strength.

name: Brimful Revival
description: Pour the whole brimming reserve into a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped to restart the heart.

name: Overbrim Oath
description: Swear the school's oath and let the vessel overflow so that every nearby ally is healed and strengthened.

name: Runoff Palm
description: Strike with a palm into which the gathered runoff of the stance is poured in one line.

name: Runoff Guard
description: Let a strike run down the guard arm and off the elbow in a shedding flow.

name: Runoff Step
description: Run downhill in the open on a thin skin of qi that keeps the stride quick.

name: Runoff Pull
description: Gather a pulling runoff round the opponent's legs and draw the body along the bearing.

name: Runoff Hold
description: Hold the runoff as a standing flow that sheds blows and throws the attackers off line.

name: Runoff Sense
description: Let the runoff spread over open ground and read every body that stands in its way.

name: Runoff Lash
description: Lash the gathered runoff down the bearing in one hard whip across the target.

name: Runoff Drag
description: Drag the opponent across the ground in a strong runoff and strike at the end of the pull.

name: Runoff Siphon
description: Draw the qi out of the opponent into the runoff and leave the foe wrung and slow.

name: Gathered Runoff
description: Gather every runoff of the open ground into one great flow and loose it across the field.

name: Swirling Palm
description: Spin a palm through a small whirl of qi that bores into the target's guard.

name: Swirl Guard
description: Spin the guard hand in a ring and wind each blow round and past the body.

name: Swirl Slide
description: Slide round the opponent in a wide open ring on a spinning skin of qi.

name: Swirl Salve
description: Turn a gentle whirl of healing qi over an ally's wound until the edges draw shut.

name: Swirl Pull
description: Spin a whirl under the opponent's feet so the strike lands on a body already turning.

name: Swirl Wash
description: Spin an open whirl of clean qi through an ally and draw out the taint in it.

name: Swirl Veil
description: Wear a turning veil of water qi that combs aside blows and throws small missiles wide.

name: Swirl Draw
description: Spin loose qi from the field into an ally so the ally's reserve and speed climb.

name: Whirlpool Crush
description: Wind a whirlpool onto the target's chest so the strike lands and grinds as it spins.

name: Drawing Whirlpool
description: Open a wide whirlpool in the field that drags every nearby opponent toward its centre.

name: Whirlpool Heart
description: Draw a heavy strike into the still centre of a whirlpool and swallow its force.

name: Whirlpool Hunger
description: Open the school's whirlpool with no wall about it and pull foe and loose qi into the turn.

name: Wellspring Palm
description: Strike with a palm fed straight from the sworn wellspring of the core.

name: Wellspring Guard
description: Let qi well up from the core to a shield that renews itself as it is struck.

name: Wellspring Step
description: Rise out of the stance on a welling of core qi and land a pace and a half away.

name: Wellspring Draw
description: Let allies drink from the welling core qi to refill their spent reserves.

name: Wellspring Mend
description: Well healing qi up from the core into an ally's wounds until they seal.

name: Wellspring Sense
description: Send the core's welling qi out through the ground and read each body that stands upon it.

name: Wellspring Burst
description: Burst the core's welling qi straight up through the fist into the target.

name: Wellspring Flood
description: Let the wellspring overflow across the ground until the opponents lose their footing.

name: Wellspring Return
description: Send the welling core qi into a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped to call the heart back.

name: Endless Wellspring
description: Open the sworn wellspring fully and feed every ally in reach with healing and strength.
